dialogue.text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent, and I'll be looking into your concerns today. I understand you've been experiencing persistent bleeding after your wisdom tooth extraction; how long has the bleeding been continuing? Also, could you tell me more about your history with easy bruising?

It's been bleeding for hours now, and even with all the gauze my mom tried to use, it just won't stop. I've always noticed that I get big bruises from even the smallest bumps at school or during gym class. My uncle actually has the same kind of problems with bleeding and his joints swelling up, too.

I see, it sounds like this has been quite a difficult day for you. Have you ever had any other surgeries or injuries in the past that resulted in prolonged bleeding like this? I'd like to order some blood work to understand why your blood isn't clotting as it should.

REQUEST TEST: Prothrombin Time (PT)
REQUEST TEST: Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (aPTT)

The prolonged partial thromboplastin time and your uncle's history of joint swelling are very significant findings. Have you personally ever experienced any painful swelling or stiffness in your knees, elbows, or ankles? 

REQUEST TEST: Factor VIII Assay
REQUEST TEST: Factor IX Assay
RESULTS: NORMAL READINGS

It's interesting that those factor levels came back normal despite your symptoms and family history. Have you noticed if your gums bleed frequently when you brush your teeth, or do you have a history of frequent nosebleeds?

REQUEST TEST: von Willebrand Factor (vWF) Antigen
REQUEST TEST: Ristocetin Cofactor Activity
